name: seafood-allergy
description: For a traveler allergic to all seafood (fish, shellfish, crustaceans, squid, octopus, and anything made from them). Ask whether seaweed is also off limits before adding the kelp-stock phrase.

phrases.ja: アレルギーはございますか

phrases.en: One of us is allergic to all seafood
phrases.ja: 一人、魚介類アレルギーの者がいます
phrases.ro: hitori, gyokairui arerugii no mono ga imasu

phrases.ja: 私は魚介類アレルギーです

phrases.en: Fish, shellfish, shrimp and crab, squid and octopus: none of it, raw or cooked
phrases.ja: 魚も貝もエビ・カニもイカ・タコも、生でも加熱していても食べられません
phrases.ro: sakana mo kai mo ebi kani mo ika tako mo, nama demo kanetsu shite ite mo taberaremasen

phrases.ja: 同行者が魚介類全般にアレルギーがあります。魚、貝類、エビ・カニなどの甲殻類、イカ・タコは、生でも加熱したものでも食べられません。かつお節や煮干しなど魚のだし、魚醤、オイスターソースなど魚介由来の調味料も同様です。魚介類を一切使っていない料理を教えていただけますか。お手数をおかけしますが、ご配慮のほどよろしくお願いいたします。
phrases.ro: One of us is allergic to all seafood: fish, shellfish, crustaceans (shrimp, crab), squid and octopus, raw or cooked. That includes fish stock (bonito flakes, dried sardines), fish sauce and oyster sauce. Could you tell us which dishes use no seafood at all?

phrases.en: Is there any seafood in this?
phrases.ja: これに魚介類は入っていますか
phrases.ro: kore ni gyokairui wa haitte imasu ka

phrases.en: Yes, it has that in it
phrases.ja: 入っています

phrases.ja: 魚介類を全く使っていない料理はどれですか
phrases.ro: gyokairui o mattaku tsukatte inai ryouri wa dore desu ka

phrases.en: Can you make it without any seafood?
phrases.ja: 魚介類を一切入れずに作れますか

phrases.ja: 加熱してあっても食べられません

phrases.en: Even a little is a problem

tips.name: Seafood allergy
items: Dashi, the stock in miso soup, udon and soba broth, oden, chawanmushi, tamagoyaki and most simmered dishes, is usually bonito (katsuobushi) plus kelp. Ask at every meal.

Hidden sources: bonito flakes on okonomiyaki, takoyaki and cold tofu; fish cake (kamaboko, chikuwa, naruto) in ramen, udon and oden; dried-sardine (niboshi) and fish-blend (gyokai) ramen broths; sakura ebi, shirasu and fish roe (ikura, mentaiko, tarako) in onigiri, pasta and toppings; furikake; shrimp crackers.

Sauces: okonomiyaki sauce and some tonkatsu sauces list oyster or fish extract, Chinese-style dishes use oyster sauce, Caesar dressing has anchovy, and tempura dipping sauce (tentsuyu) is dashi. Ask for salt with tempura.
Packaged food must label shrimp and crab, but fish, squid, salmon, mackerel and roe are only recommended labels. Read the ingredients for 魚, だし, かつお, 魚醤 and 魚介エキス.
Safer bets, still ask: yakiniku, tonkatsu without the sauce, yakitori with salt, Japanese curry, shojin ryori (Buddhist vegetarian) restaurants, and sukiyaki or shabu-shabu with a kelp-only broth.

if seaweed is safe.ja: 昆布だしだけなら大丈夫です
if seaweed is safe.ro: konbu dashi dake nara daijoubu desu

travelers_note: One traveler is allergic to all seafood, raw or cooked: fish, shellfish, crustaceans, squid and octopus, plus fish stock, bonito flakes, fish sauce and oyster sauce.
